fields.name: ATSSS container IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for ATSSS container

fields.name: Length of ATSSS container contents
fields.description: Length of the ATSSS container contents

fields.name: ATSSS container contents
fields.description: ATSSS container contents defined in 3GPP TS 24.193

notes: The ATSSS container is a type 6 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 65538 octets.
ATSSS container contents are defined in 3GPP TS 24.193 [13B].
